user.title: Monoprice Blackbird 4x4
user.description: Enter the address of the matrix's web interface. If the web interface can't be used, nearby TCP control ports are tried automatically.{details}

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the matrix, e.g. 192.168.1.39.

names.title: Name your inputs and outputs
names.description: Optional: give the sources and displays friendly names, such as "Apple TV" or "Living Room TV". Leave any field blank to keep its default name ("Input 1", "Output 1", ...). You can change these later under Configure.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the matrix. Check the IP address and that it is on the network.
error.unknown_protocol: Something answered at that address but it didn't respond like a supported Blackbird matrix. The device's reply is shown above; send it to the integration's GitHub issues.

abort.already_in_progress: Setup for this matrix is already in progress. Close the other setup dialog, or restart Home Assistant, and try again.

init.title: Blackbird 4x4 options
init.description: Name the inputs and outputs (leave blank for the defaults) and set how often the matrix is polled.

set_all_outputs.name: Set all outputs
set_all_outputs.description: Route one input to every output.

config_entry_id.name: Matrix
config_entry_id.description: The matrix to control. Optional when only one is configured.

send_command.name: Send command
send_command.description: Send a raw command in the matrix's own command set and return its reply, for example a5 5b 02 01 01 (PN 39668 hex frame, checksum added automatically), r av out 0!, or OUT01:02. on older Blackbird firmware.

config_entry_id.name: Matrix
config_entry_id.description: The matrix to control. Optional when only one is configured.

command.name: Command
command.description: The command. The terminator (! or .) is added if missing.
